root.text: Warden Halrik claps a hand onto the stone parapet and looks out over the sea. "Welcome to the Proving Isle, recruit. Before you sail for the Northern Realms, the Ashen Ledger, or stranger shores, let us sharpen your instincts here."

choices.label: "I found this hidden Signet of the First Warden in Whispering Grove!"
"The Wayfarer Beacon is lit! I am ready to graduate."

briefing.text: "Four simple habits keep a hero alive: check your Inventory to equip weapons, armor, and rings; visit Artisan Brann northeast on the Forge Terrace to practice crafting and combining gear; clear the Old Watchtower Ruins southeast (and solve its Rune Archway); then climb Proving Beacon Cliff to the south, defeat the Sentinel, and ignite the Beacon."

choices.label: "Any tips for multi-enemy fights or magic?"

tactics_tip.text: "When enemies form two rows, melee strikes must break the frontline first, while bows and spells like Coastal Gale Wave reach the backline. Check your Character Grimoire as your skills grow to unlock new spells, and talk to Scout Pippin in Whispering Grove if you want a companion at your side."

finish_hidden.text: Halrik lets out a delighted laugh. "You actually searched the cedar roots! Most recruits march right past that hollow. Keep the First Warden's Signet on your hand; observant eyes like yours will uncover hidden missions in every campaign you play."

graduate.text: Halrik raises his lantern in salute as emerald fire reflects off the sea. "Well fought and well reasoned! You have mastered travel, trade, craft, riddles, and battle. Take this Warden's Proven Halberd and your Sealed Wayfarer Charter. Whenever you are ready, open the Campaigns menu to begin any full adventure!"

root.text: Sera taps a neat wooden ledger beside racks of salves and toolkits. "Need lockpicks for the Watchtower chest, a whetstone for your spear, or crafting materials for Brann? Open Trade anytime, and remember your Inventory has dedicated tabs for Rings & Jewelry, Consumables, and Tools & Materials."

choices.label: "I will open your Trade menu to browse supplies."

root.text: Sparks dance off Brann's hammer as he grins. "Ready to learn the two crafts of the road? At the Craft & Forge tab you combine two materials into a concealed creation; inside Inventory you can combine a Whetstone with your Training Spear or rub Ember Resin onto any blade."

choices.label: "Teach me! Give me the Blade & Crucible trial."
"I crafted a new piece and tested a field combination!"
"I'll try the forge and come back."

start_craft_trial.text: "Splendid! Take this Smithing Toolkit, a River Whetstone, and a spare Iron Bar. Loot the Artisan Supply Crate right beside me for extra timber and resin, then craft one item in Craft & Forge and combine two items in your Inventory."

choices.label: "Grab the spare whetstone and iron too."

give_extras.text: Brann tosses you a coastal whetstone and a bar of iron. "Remember: click Use on... or drag one item onto another in Inventory to combine!"

finish_craft_trial.text: Brann inspects your handiwork with a proud nod. "Clean edge and solid temper! Take this Herbalist Field Mortar and a Sea-Glass Rune Shard so you can keep experimenting."

root.text: Scout Pippin waves from the pine trail. "Watch the bracken ahead: a Briarthorn Wolf has been snapping at recruits trying to reach the Wayfarer Shrine. Want a hand on the trails, or ready to clear the wolf?"

choices.label: "I'll clear the Briarthorn Wolf from Whispering Grove."
"The Briarthorn Wolf has been driven off."
"Want to travel together as my companion?"

start_grove.text: "Good luck! After the fight, try using a Sunleaf Healing Salve or taking a Short Rest if you take a scratch, and don't forget to click Search Area here to look for hidden caches!"

finish_grove.text: "Nicely handled! The shrine path is clear again. Take this Ember-Spiced Vigor Tonic for the Watchtower Ruins."

recruit.text: Pippin grins and slings his quiver tight. "Gladly! Two pairs of eyes beat one in the Watchtower Ruins. Lead the way!"
